entries.0ad9d114e6ea1417: Companies that develop and promote human resources
entries.1382c8880bc0a10d: It is an aptitude test provided by the consolidated subsidiary e-Falcon Co., Ltd. It can assess a person's traits across 80 trait items, and is used consistently from recruitment screening through development, placement and promotion. It is also installed as standard in OfferBox. Revenue for the fiscal year ended March 2026 was ¥313 million.
entries.627f71c32186fb4d: This flat-fee plan allows companies to send offers to students before the official start of recruitment publicity. Usage fees and recruitment slot fees are received in a lump sum at contract signing, and revenue is recognized as the service period elapses. Revenue for the fiscal year ended March 2026 was ¥4,488 million.
entries.750f1da29226f3b5: A company that operates "OfferBox," a job-hunting service for new graduates in which companies send offers directly to students.
entries.75d00531e95a4265: It covers revenue from new businesses and from the food-industry-focused job-hunting event service 'Tsunagaru Shukatsu', operated by the consolidated subsidiary Maximize Co., Ltd., among others. The group also operates the membership community space 'OfferBox VVV Station' and the career university business 'OfferBox mirai'. Revenue for the fiscal year ended March 2026 was ¥299 million.
entries.d0a5737745fd137d: This fee plan allows offers to be sent from the official start date of recruitment publicity onward, with fees arising when an agreement to join is reached. There is no introduction fee, and under the contract the success fee is refunded if a candidate withdraws from an offer of employment, which reduces the burden on companies. Revenue for the fiscal year ended March 2026 was ¥654 million.
entries.fd77c1456822aa26: This single segment provides the new-graduate offer-type job-hunting service “OfferBox,” the aptitude testing service “eF-1G,” and the food-industry-focused job-hunting event service “Tsunagaru Shukatsu.” Consolidated subsidiary E-Falcon Inc. handles eF-1G, and Maximize Inc. handles Tsunagaru Shukatsu. Revenue for the fiscal year ended March 2026 was ¥5,756 million.
